prompt: Stage 3-5, level 6, 40 gold, 12 XP from level 7, 70 HP. You want a 4-cost carry. Per shop slot, 4-costs appear 5% of the time at level 6, 10% at level 7 and 30% at level 8 (level 8 is another 76 XP after 7). Which is the cheapest way to make 4-costs show up in your shop?

options.label: Buy 12 XP (12 gold) for level 7 first: 4-costs double from 5% to 10% per slot, then refresh
Stay level 6 and refresh: a refresh is 2 gold and an XP purchase is 4, so refreshing is cheaper
Go straight to level 8 now, where 4-costs are 30%

explanation:
The shop is drawn from odds that depend on your level. The table for 1/2/3/4/5-costs is 30/40/25/5/0 at level 6, 16/30/43/10/1 at level 7 and 15/20/32/30/3 at level 8. At level 6 a refresh shows five slots at 5% each: about one 4-cost every four refreshes, 8 gold apiece. At level 7 that doubles to about one every two refreshes, and the odds stay for the rest of the game while a refresh is gone once the round ends. 12 gold for level 7 is paid once and pays back on every shop from here on.

Level 8 is the real 4-cost level (30%), but it costs 12 gold plus another 76 XP, 88 gold in total, and you have 40. Refreshing at level 6 feels cheap because each click is 2 gold, and it is the most expensive line: most of the 40 gold buys shops full of 1- and 2-costs you do not want. Level first, then refresh.
principle: Higher levels show more expensive champions. Buy the level before you buy the refreshes.
commonMistake: Refreshing at a low level for a champion the level barely offers, because 2 gold a click feels cheaper than 4.
hint: Compare what 12 gold buys as XP (a permanent change in the odds) against what the same 12 gold buys as six refreshes at 5%.
